notes.title: Aircraft Sketch Shooter now Available for 0,99$
notes.content:
[h1]Grüße Follower und Gamer,[/h1]

Seit dem Start von Aircraft Sketch Shooter ist viel passiert. Wir haben das Spiel mehrmals verbessert, Fehler behoben und versucht, unseren Spielern eine gute Erfahrung in Aircraft Sketch Shooter zu bieten.

Da wir unseren Highscore-Server abschalten mussten, haben wir die Global Leaderboards aus dem Spiel entfernt und sind nicht mehr verfügbar. Dies erlaubt uns auch, den Preis zu senken, da es keine zusätzlichen Kosten mehr gibt.

Es hat wirklich Spaß gemacht, dieses Spiel zu entwickeln. Wir werden auch in Zukunft an weiteren Spielen arbeiten, also folge uns, um auf dem Laufenden zu bleiben.

[h2]Und jetzt schnapp dir dein Aircraft Sketch Shooter Exemplar für nur 0,99$[/h2]

notes.title: Server Issues #1
notes.content:
Hello Players,

actually we having some issues with our Highscore-Server which we wanted to maintain and change some things for our upcoming Game which will be Announced in a Couple Days, it went slightly wrong and the whole API for Aircraft Sketch Shooter is lost and has to be rewritten.

We expecting the Highscore-System to be back Up at 05.05.2021 - 06.05.2021

notes.title: Linux + SteamOS Support and Patch for Update #2
notes.content:
Hello Community,

We wanna say Thanks to all the Feedback and Bug Reports we got from you the Players.

To make the best Game possible we wanna improve ourself and continue working on Aircraft Sketch Shooter.

Today we gonna Publish Aircraft Sketch Shooter to Linux and SteamOS. We would love to have Feedback from Linux Users and how it works on their System.

Get in Contact with us on Social@Stusse-Games.com to give us Feedback and Report Bugs if you find them, your Support is really Appreciated.

Here a List of Bug Fix we have done:
- Mouse Cursor was not available to Start the Game
Should be now Fixed and everyone can start the Game.
- Heavy Lags when Steam Users receive a Message via Steam Overlay.
We set the Game back to Fullscreen Mode instead of Window Fullscreen. This should solve the Problem. If you wanna play in Window Mode you can use "Alt+Enter" Key to Change it.
- Controller Detection
We Checked the Controller Detection to ensure that the Controller gets detected at all Time.

Additional:
We Added a Alternate Shot Key (Spacebar) and Alternate Bomb Key (Left-Control)
You can Change your Key binding in the Settings. 


Good Luck on your future Flights in Aircraft Sketch Shooter
Thank you all

notes.title: Update #2 Multilanguage, Weapon System Rework and User interface
notes.content:
Update #2 For Aircraft Sketch Shooter goes Live.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3Fs7LHJmGAA

We Improving the Gameplay and Overall Experience in Aircraft Sketch Shooter.

[h2]Additional Available Languages[/h2]
Aircraft Sketch Shooter will be now available in Multiple Languages.
English, German, Japanese, Russian, Spanish, Chinese (Simplified) and Portuguese-
The Game detects your System Language and change the Language based on your System.

[spoiler](We are Using the AI Translator DeepL to bring our Game to other Languages, Translations will be not 100% and Perfect, we still looking for People to help us with a real Translation, Reach out on us)[/spoiler]

[h2]New User Interface[/h2]
The whole User Interface has been Changed to improve the Visual Quality of the Menus and the Game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39154214/fa2758070a8f08accc3d5d3f6967f75d07a8b063.jpg[/img]

[h2]Weapon System Rework[/h2]
We reworked the Weapon System to make it more reliable and easier to Understand
New Weapon Interface to display your Weapon Status.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39154214/0d67991e21d154c6fdae976c6ebccd365ead0370.jpg[/img]

[h2]Power Up Redesign[/h2]
We have redesigned the Power Ups to make them easier to Collect and Visible.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39154214/5f073fd414ba52a3aecb2a93f464800c4b578c05.jpg[/img]

[h2]Tutorials[/h2]
We have added Tutorials to the Game, to help you to understand the Interface and Power Ups.

[h2]Choose your Style at the Beginning[/h2]
We added another Scene at the Beginning so the Player can select the Graphic Style he wants to Play. This ensures also that everyone see this Feature of Aircraft Sketch Shooter.

[h2]Other Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] We Fixed a Glitch in Level 5 were the Arrows of the Boss didn't disappear.
[*] The Level 5 Boss has now a bigger duration before he goes in Transition.
[*] We Improved the Shooting Sound Quality of the Normal and Special Shot.
[/list]


Join Us on the Highscore Races, Setup your Highscore now!
Follow us on our Social Media Accounts and on the Steam Curator Page to get Notifications and Updates about our upcoming Updates and future Titles.

https://taplink.cc/stussegames

notes.title: Coming Soon Big Update #2 Multilanguage, new User Interface and more!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39154214/76beeabdbdc08d15e5d391d079b0f12b6e3d9ca5.jpg[/img]

We are improving Aircraft Sketch Shooter to give you a better Experience to play our Game.

We are going to Change the User Interface, we are adding new Elements and also Change the Visuals of Power Ups.

[h2]Weapon System[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39154214/0d67991e21d154c6fdae976c6ebccd365ead0370.jpg[/img]
To smooth the Weapon Systems they getting a Range from 0 - 100
The Weapon Power Up will not increased anymore by 1 and has 3 Stages.
It will increased around 20
Instead of a 32% Chance to loose a Power Up Level, the Aircraft loose now with every Hit Points.

[h3]Old Interface[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39154214/0290ec1af117f01d85a21668a9886c018f402be3.jpg[/img]
[h3]New Interface[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39154214/907cc05604d3d6dc3dfc575d917a7fd03383f833.jpg[/img]

[h3]Tutorials:[/h3]
The Player will be slowly Introduced to the Game and its Powerups over the First 4 Levels.

[h3]Power Ups Rework[/h3]
We implemented the reworked Version of the Power Ups, we will Increase the Size to make them better visible during the Game and easier to Catch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39154214/5f073fd414ba52a3aecb2a93f464800c4b578c05.jpg[/img]

[h3]Multilanguage[/h3]
The Game will be available in addition to English, now also in German, Russian and Japanese.

[h3]Choose Your Style[/h3]
One of the Cool Gimmick of the Game is to Change the Visual Style the Player can Play with. This can be Changed during Runtime, but a lot of Players are missing this Feature, since they are not looking in the Settings. So when you first Start the Game now you can Choose your Style to play with.


There will be some more Changes to the Game, which will be in the Patch Notes.
Follow Stusse Games and Stay Informed about the Upcoming Update.
